constraint_prompts.purpose: the poem's own lines are verified and timed to this reel
constraint_prompts.prompt: It was the type of silent scream a trapped lover makes to escape: a pending marriage, a concussion, a set of walls caving inward. An emergency call while tossing and turning — the silent call a man makes to the mirror after midnight, to digest a truth. A winless insomnia. An epiphany of a road winding down. My eyes dilate — and we go through. I was six, I recall, when the ghost of a dead and love-less seven-year-old appeared, and shared that my parents Curtains pulled, and blinds up as far and as wise as possible — to see flashing lights, and the whispering screams of two souls on a road winding down. And no tears, and no fucks, and no love to give. The ghost hands me a tambourine — and I throw it through the window.
